thread:
maya (PM): quick sync — we need a clear decision on the short-commit onramp shape. sales want something they can pitch next week. the ask: allow 3-month commit with credits + opt-in priority lane.
kevin (Sales Eng): +1 from AE side. customers will push for both predictable burn and a way to not overcommit. major Q is: softcap vs hard cap?
maya (PM): thinking softcap that morphs into overage billing after threshold, but with a grace window and credit smoothing. keeps sales promises but protects ops.
tori (Product Ops): can we make the opt-in priority lane an add-on toggle so it doesn't complicate core sku? toggle would wire into routing policy and priority queue.
liz (Finance): need clear revenue recognition and refund rules. if we give credits + grace, define how credits convert to rev and what happens on churn. also, pricing for priority lane should be explicit.
kevin (Sales Eng): for pitch simplicity, AEs want one-line: "3mo commit -> X credits + optional Priority Lane for Y% uplift". add a sample contract clause.
maya (PM): sample clause draft: ```
Customer purchases a 3-month commitment for N tokens. Redwood grants N*0.9 usage credits and an optional Priority Lane add-on. Unused credits expire at term end; usage beyond credits billed at on-demand rates. A 30-day grace buffer allows temporary overages without immediate billing; sustained overages convert to prorated charge.
```
liz (Finance): tweak: credits should equal N minus a 10% reserve for quality guarantees, mention prorate formula explicitly. also metadata: SKU code, revenue bucket.
tori (Product Ops): implementation notes for eng/runtime: expose a new route-level flag `priority_lane=true` and a commit_id that maps to credit balance. prefer ephemeral redirect rather than a new model type. @pricing-bot can we auto-provision commit record?
pricing-bot: created commit record 4155554321-commit-qa (status: provisioned) :white_check_mark:
kevin (Sales Eng): nice. can we add a trial convert path if they hit softcap early? sales often want auto-roll into longer commit with incentives.
maya (PM): can do as a follow-up — we need launch criteria for MLP: (1) SKU defined, (2) billing flow validated, (3) priority routing integrated, (4) docs + AE playbook ready.
kevin (Sales Eng): timeline: if we lock this by EOD Thursday, AEs can start pilots next week.
tori (Product Ops): tagging this as "dev-preview" and will open the rollout checklist. also adding an eval path for quality/regression tied to priority lane.
liz (Finance): approve dev-preview terms but require explicit sunset/rollback rules if revenue recognition problems show up.
maya (PM): thanks — i'll capture decisions and spin a short spec. next steps: i'll post the spec in this thread with SKU numbers and sample contract language. :thumbsup:
